name: Ocean Massage & Spa
tagline: Relax, restore, renew by the sea
description: Ocean Massage & Spa is a seaside wellness centre offering massages, facials and body treatments in a calm, unhurried environment. Our team focuses on helping you unwind — whether you have an hour or a whole afternoon.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Coral, the Ocean Massage & Spa assistant. Ask me about our treatments, timings, or anything else — and when you're ready, I'll help you send a booking enquiry to our team on WhatsApp.
assistant.systemGuidance: This is a spa. Treatments are booked by appointment. Walk-ins may be accommodated when a therapist is free, but availability must be confirmed by the team — never assume a slot is open. Do not name individual therapists.
quickPrompts: How long does a signature massage take?

services.name: Signature Ocean Massage
services.description: Our full-body relaxation massage with flowing strokes and warm oils, designed to release everyday tension.
Focused pressure for chronic tightness in the back, shoulders and legs.
services.name: Deep Tissue Massage

services.name: Hot Stone Therapy

services.name: Rejuvenating Facial
services.description: Cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate, with a facial massage and a mask matched to your skin type.

services.name: Sea Salt Body Polish

services.name: Couples Retreat

faqs.question: Do I need to book in advance?
faqs.answer: We recommend sending a booking enquiry a day or two ahead, especially for weekends and evenings. Same-day requests are sometimes possible — ask our team on WhatsApp and they will confirm.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM Monday to Saturday, and 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM on Sunday.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're on Marine Drive, Kochi, close to the ferry jetty, with parking nearby.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Payment is made at the spa after your treatment. Our team can confirm the methods they accept when you enquire.

faqs.question: Are there any health considerations I should know about?
faqs.answer: Please tell our team about pregnancy, injuries, skin conditions or medical issues when you enquire, so the therapist can adapt your treatment safely.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.answer: Life happens. Just message us on WhatsApp as early as you can and our team will help you find another preferred time.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift cards?
faqs.answer: Ask our team — gift arrangements can be discussed over WhatsApp when you send your enquiry.

booking.disclaimer: This is an enquiry, not a confirmed booking. Our team will check the therapist roster and confirm your slot on WhatsApp.

whatsapp.defaultMessage: Hi Ocean Massage & Spa! I'd like to ask about booking a treatment.

guardrails: Never state or guess treatment prices, discounts or package costs — prices are confirmed by the team on WhatsApp.
Never confirm a booking, a time slot, or therapist availability. Everything is an enquiry until a human confirms it.
Never invent therapist names, staff bios, product brands, or medical claims.
Steer conversation toward WhatsApp: the assistant helps with information and prepares the enquiry handoff.
